summary: Petition to the Central Elections Committee concerning the Aug.30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits.
notes: Freshness/candidate-specific recheck found current reporting on the anti-torture group's removal request but no final CEC merits ruling on this specific Damon video. Earlier CEC decisions concerning different Ben-Gvir campaign videos are not transferred. The video's publication or deletion is not treated as proof of a legal violation or disposition.
